animations.batch1: 5 expressions x 7 states = 35 animations. Shipped as CSS motion loops over the static poster (see portrait-motion-* in app/src/styles.css) with videoUrl null in PRESET_ANIMATIONS, because no mp4/gif files can be pushed through the MCP text-only file tools. Real video playback exists for uploaded videos via the new portrait_media table and the <video> branch in AbstractAvatar; preset mp4 files are pending a binary-capable push.
animations.batch2: dance videos, and the 25 outfit x expression combinations x 7 states = 175 animations.

combinations.note: 5 outfits x 5 expressions = 25 combinations. These are NOT plain crops: each needs the expression head composited onto the outfit body (head-swap), so they are listed here only as the cutting plan, not as crop boxes.

license: PENDING USER CONFIRMATION — the sheet is the user's own design material; confirm its licence/permission before shipping any crop as a preset.

presetPosters.cutCommand: ffmpeg -i <sheet.webp> -vf "crop=SIZE:SIZE:X:Y" <slug>.png  (one crop per entry above; square-crop, then resize to 256px for the picker)
presetPosters.status: The five shipped preset posters are still the existing xiongbao-{cool,cute,happy,naughty,sweet}.png in @/assets/brand/. Bao crops are not in the repo yet: binary files cannot be pushed through the GitHub MCP file tools (text only), so the crops must be cut and pushed through a binary-capable path (git push from a machine with the files). Until then this manifest is the cutting list, not the assets.

source.note: Crops below are measured on the 1392x1680 pinyin sheet. Head centres were located by visual grounding (0-1000 scale) and converted to pixels; each crop box is centre +/- half the side, clamped to the sheet. Re-measure before cutting, do not trust these numbers blindly.
